text_block_list.text:
Since an exhibition race was taking place,
I visited the racetrack to watch.

In that day's race were
Satono Diamond, Cheval Grand—

and Sounds of Earth, among many other
formidable contenders.

The runners clashed fiercely,
putting on a thrilling race where they
poured out their fighting spirit until the very end...!

After soaking in the afterglow, I decided to head
to the waiting room to praise the participating
horse girls and staff. But then—
(*BAMMMM!*)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my—?!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Dia!! That race was incredible!!
So awesome!! You worked so haaard!!

Blast One Piece had thrown her arms around
Satono Diamond with all her might.
With her tall build, the hug looked dynamic...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Blast-san. Thank you for
coming to watch. ♪

Perhaps watching the race had really energized her,
as Blast One Piece seemed completely pumped up.
However—
(*BAMMMMMMM!*)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa...?!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Chevaaaal!! You did so great!!
You were super cool out there again todayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-B-Blast-san...?! 
Ah, u-um...

Blast One Piece showed no signs
of slowing down whatsoever—
(*BAMMMMMMMMM!!*)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Con!! Brio...rrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Earth!! You were amazing today too!!
You were shining so, so brighttt!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Grazie.
Ever the passionate abandon, as always.

She tackled all three with hugs like an energetic big dog.
That said, none of them seemed to mind.
It must be a regular occurrence, given how natural it looked.
choice_data_list: (She really loves everyone, and they love her back.)

text_block_list.text: —However, my relief was short-lived.

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Trainers, thank you all too for helping everyone run!!
Here's a thank-you hug for you too~♪

This time, she opened her arms wide and came
charging straight at me for a hug—!

Taken by surprise by the sudden charge,
I let out a loud shout.

Besides, I wasn't even involved in today's event,
so getting hugged felt a bit undeserved...!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's the matter?
What happened~?

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you were just passing by!
Sorry for startling you like that...!

She had just gotten carried away; there was no bad intent.
She quickly apologized with genuine remorse.
choice_data_list: (She must have a really warm and gentle heart.)

text_block_list.text:
She rejoices in others' hard work
as if it were her own.
I realized what a truly kind girl she was.
choice_data_list: I'll be cheering for your races too.
I'll be rooting for your races as well.
I can tell how much you love everyone.

text_block_list.text:
She rejoices in others' hard work
as if it were her own.
I realized what a truly kind girl she was.
choice_data_list: I'll be cheering for your races too.
I'll be rooting for your races as well.
I can tell how much you love everyone.

text_block_list.text: I told her I was looking forward to seeing her run out on the track.
I told her I was eagerly anticipating when it would be her turn to race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed♪
Since Blast-san is always cheering us on,
I'm very much looking forward to your race too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm... um, cheering for you too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì. Pray, let me hear your vivace musica!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, ehehe! I'm so happy!
I looooove all of you so much!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right!
I really love everyone!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
I really, really, really
love you all so muchhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Fortississimoooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Sorry, Earth! I went in for a hug
and crashed right into you...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, think nothing of it, sweet amore.
Receiving your passione makes my heart
cry out 'Brava!' in turn!
